content_blocks.label: clause_1._Nature_of_Action
content_blocks.text: Plaintiff brings this action to recover damages for breach of contract as alleged in the complaint.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Factual_Background
content_blocks.text: On March 1, 2024, Plaintiff entered into a contract with Defendant for the provision of consulting services, which was subsequently breached by Defendant.
